label: Rigidified actual approval is the alternative to the rigidity bridge
note: Target: the rigidity bridge. Mechanism: goodness is fixed to the assessor's actual approvals, so it keeps invariance while non-actual approvals vary; then base coextension does not spread (Controls proves the rigidified account excludes the bridge, and the rigidified artifact model witnesses it). Independent justification: rigidified dispositional or response-dependent theories of value (unread leads). Price: approval no longer makes the difference in the varied profiles; goodness tracks one actual set of attitudes.
